prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent static battle-form cutout for an original woodland card battler, judged at 13 px tall
Primary request: Draw the concealed state of the original Buried Coil structure as one simple, unmistakable arena silhouette.
Subject: A low, fully closed round copper hatch that sits nearly flush with the ground; broad flattened rim, exactly three large dark rivet heads spaced around it, and one short bright emberseed slit at the center. It is still hidden: no tower, mast, legs, or rising parts.
Style/medium: Original hand-painted game asset with bold compact shapes, a strong dark contour, restrained broad highlights, and simple metal and rootwood materials.
Composition/framing: Single centered top three-quarter view, square canvas, hatch large in frame, complete rim inside bounds with a little transparent margin. Keep the outer shape readable when the whole image is shown at 13 px high.
Color: Shared copper and dark rootwood body with one amber emberseed point; no side-specific colors because the game team plate is a separate frontmost overlay.
Background: Genuinely transparent, no floor, scenery, cast shadow, smoke, splash, or glow outside the hatch.
Constraints: Original device only. No text, lettering, logo, watermark, border, UI, characters, weapons, or extra objects. Make a flat closed hatch silhouette that clearly differs from the raised tower form.
